{{Quote|The first two charges work you over. The third one kills you.|Bossk|<ref name="TMA" />}}
The '''incremental-sequence bomb''' was an explosive device that was designed to detonate in sequences. The detonation patterns began as minor explosions and became more powerful with each subsequent explosion such that the final explosion was capable of destroying most [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. An incremental-sequence [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] was installed within a [[Slave I decoy|decoy vessel]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] starship, the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], fellow bounty hunters [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] boarded the decoy ship in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] outside the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild's]] [[Bounty Hunters' Guild complex|headquarters]] to confirm whether Fett was on board; however, they discovered the ship to be a fake and accidentally triggered the bomb. Bossk and Zuckuss barely made their escape in [[Time/Legends|time]] and were forced to put in for repairs after the bomb disabled Bossk's ship, the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']].

==Description==
{{Quote|We... we should be okay now.... That wasn't... much of a bomb....|Zuckuss, just after he and Bossk escaped the first of three explosions|<ref name="TMA" />}}
The incremental-sequence [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] was a [[black]] cylinder that was studded with [[Sensor/Legends|biosensors]] and equipped with a miniaturized [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] system. The device was capable of locking onto and tracking a target throughout its detonation sequence.<ref name="TMA" />

Incremental-sequence bombs were designed to detonate in a three-part sequential pattern, with each explosion more powerful than the last. The first sequence of the bomb's detonation pattern was described as a minor explosion and was intended to lure the prey into assuming that the bomb was a mere distraction. The second explosion, however, was calibrated to throw the intended target off-guard, and the third and final explosion was large and destructive, able to disable or outright destroy most [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="TMA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Now, this is interesting. I wouldn't have expected something like this aboard a simple decoy vessel.''"<br />"''What is it?''"<br />"''Offhand... I'd say it's a bomb....|Zuckuss and Bossk|<ref name="TMA" />}}
One time, a incremental-sequence bomb was installed within a [[Slave I decoy|decoy]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] ship, the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. The decoy vessel was encountered in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] outside the perimeter of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild's]] [[Bounty Hunters' Guild complex|headquarters]] by the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by fellow bounty hunters, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], the former still ruminating over his failure to capture [[Nil Posondum]]&mdash;a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] that Bossk had intended to acquire before Fett beat him to it. In his anger, Bossk, thinking that the ship was the real ''Slave I'', fired at the vessel in an attempt to destroy the rival hunter before he could reach the Bounty Hunters' Guild.<ref name="TMA" />

In order to confirm the kill, Bossk piloted and docked his ship with the supposed ''Slave I''. He and Zuckuss boarded the vessel and explored its interior until Zuckuss discovered that it was a decoy. It was during that exploration that Zuckuss happened upon the incremental-sequence bomb. The device was triggered by the Gand's approach, forcing both he and Bossk to flee to the ''Hound's Tooth'', barely escaping in [[Time/Legends|time]]. The resulting explosions devastated Bossk's ship, and he and Zuckuss were forced to put in for repairs prior to returning to the Guild's headquarters.<ref name="TMA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The incremental-sequence bomb was created by [[K. W. Jeter]] for his [[June]] [[1998]] novel, ''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]'', the first book of [[The Bounty Hunter Wars]] trilogy.
